notice: Sample quotations for the layout. These are not reviews from real clients. Do not present them as verified feedback. Replace each entry with a real client's words, used with permission, and set verified to true only then. Star ratings appear only on verified entries.

items.quote: I came with a list of questions and left with the chart explained in language I could repeat to my family. Nothing was rushed, and nothing was dressed up as a certainty.
items.name: Sample Client A

items.quote: The consultation was quiet and specific. I was told what the tradition suggests, and also what it does not decide for me. That honesty is what I would want from a reading.
items.name: Sample Client B

items.quote: We had come for a marriage discussion. Both charts were explained with patience, without pressure on either family and without treating the matching as a verdict.
items.name: Sample Client C

items.quote: I appreciated that uncertainty about my birth time was discussed openly, instead of being ignored so the reading could sound more precise than it was.
items.name: Sample Client D
